summary: Anden is an offline-first mobile app featuring an intelligent AI agricultural consultant that lets farmers register their plots, compare crop rotations, and chat for personalized guidance. Addressing the Field Shift challenge, Anden integrates NASA POWER agro-climatic observations and Open-Meteo weather data with local soil, water, and cost metrics to recommend resilient rotations. This tool is vital because smallholder farmers face climate shifts and soil degradation without accessible technical support. Anden translates complex satellite data into actionable, offline-ready advice that protects soil health, conserves water, and boosts farm profitability.
details:
Anden is an offline-first, multilingual mobile application with geolocation designed to help farmers plan climate-resilient crop rotations. Through an intuitive interface, farmers can register their agricultural plots, compare rotation scenarios, and chat directly with an intelligent AI agricultural consultant. Under the hood, the platform runs custom calculation engines for irrigation, economic analysis, crop rotation, and agricultural scenario simulation, cross-referencing NASA POWER, Open-Meteo, and SRTM elevation data to recommend optimal, cost-effective crops—such as choosing resilient alfalfa over water-intensive potatoes.

Beyond its core features, Anden delivers tangible benefits and long-term impact for rural communities. By combining geospatial analytics with local economic modeling, it helps farmers conserve scarce water, reduce input costs, and protect soil health before planting. Crucially, its offline operation, geolocation, and multilingual support democratize NASA Earth science for smallholder farmers working in remote fields without stable internet connectivity.

To bring this solution to life, we built a modern, scalable architecture integrating mobile, geospatial, and cloud technologies. The mobile app was developed with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript, backed by a Python and FastAPI server connected to a PostgreSQL and PostGIS geospatial database. For intelligence and environmental data, we integrated Gemini 3.5 Flash via Google Vertex AI alongside NASA POWER, Open-Meteo, and SRTM, all deployed on Google Cloud Platform using Docker and Caddy.

Finally, what makes Anden truly creative—and guided our engineering decisions—is how it bridges ancestral farming wisdom with space-age technology. Inspired by ancient Andean agricultural terraces (andenes), we replaced complex GIS dashboards with a conversational mobile advisor tailored to real-world constraints. Throughout development, our multidisciplinary team (spanning Systems, Agro-industrial, and Industrial Engineering) carefully factored in rural connectivity limits, crop production economics, soil regeneration, and mobile usability.
